lead: A timeline: data-driven and vertical; each item has a time, a dot or icon (with a line to the next item), a title and a description.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: The list and each item; when any item has a `time`, the root gets `data-has-time` and every item an extra time column
styling.time: The time text on the left
styling.dot: The dot and the line to the next item; the dot gets `data-has-icon` when it holds an icon, and a pending item `data-pending`
